name: BACH_0364
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (65%)** · Confident · Careful review
Single-class conformal set [F1], but 34% InSitu probability, foundation-model disagreement, and 4/5 InSitu neighbors require caution.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Invasive 65%, InSitu 34%, Benign 0%, Normal 0% | Leans Invasive; substantial InSitu probability |
| Conformal set | Invasive (α=10%, 90% test coverage) | Single class; dataset-level guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 54% reliability, 36th OOD percentile, 12/12 regions [F6] | Acceptable input; unflagged (AUROC 70%) |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | False | Foundation models disagree on top |
| Similar cases | 1/5 Invasive (20%), 4/5 InSitu [F5] | Nearest neighbors predominantly InSitu |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 10) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.73 SD) lowers invasive read (-0.46) [F2] · Validated
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Scarce benign stroma (-0.39 SD) raises invasive read (+0.30) [F3] · Validated
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 2, 9) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical confinement (+1.27 SD) lowers invasive read (-0.23) [F4] · Weak
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 0, 3, 9) · ↑ invasive · High score (+1.07 SD, +0.22), but 3/20 AI spot-check · Unreliable
- **Tumor cell density & nuclei** (regions 2, 6) · context · Density 95th percentile [F7], size CV 93rd [F9], size 0th [F8] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top-3 risk regions drops invasive score above random (0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021 to 0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (95% CI -0.0088 to 0.0064 includes 0); leans on unreliable necrosis (3/20), normal_lobules (0/20), mitoses (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- True diagnosis is InSitu (34% probability), matching 4/5 neighbors and 94%-similar InSitu case BACH_0057 (differs in pleomorphism, mitoses).
- High-risk regions (0, 3, 6) reflect intraductal atypia rather than stromal invasion, which scored below typical.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 3, 6, 0**: Highest risk (100%, 99%, 96%); confirm invasion before releasing drafted ER/PR/HER2/Ki-67 stain orders.
2. **Regions 2, 9**: Strongest duct-confined atypia scores (low risk 4%, 6%); verify tumor remains confined within ducts.
3. **Regions 10, 11**: Check weak stromal infiltration score (region 10) and lymphocytic infiltrate with benign stroma (region 11).
